# Moonrise Coffee

A small neighborhood café that roasts its own beans every Tuesday and Friday.

## Find us

14 Alder Lane, Portland. Open 7:00–16:00 on weekdays and 8:00–15:00 on weekends. Closed on Mondays.

## On the menu

- Filter coffee, 3.50
- Flat white, 4.50
- Cardamom bun, 4.00
- Seasonal toast, 7.00

## Beans to take home

Three single-origin coffees, roasted in house, sold in 250 g bags. Ask at the counter what is fresh this week.
